title: Temperature Converter
description:
Convert 100 degrees Celsius to both Fahrenheit and Kelvin. Use the formulas:
- Fahrenheit = (Celsius × 9/5) + 32
- Kelvin = Celsius + 273.15

Print each result rounded to 2 decimal places.

**Expected output:**
```
Celsius: 100
Fahrenheit: 212.0
Kelvin: 373.15
```
